newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's short-term PHIBOR rates higher.
newsitem.headline: Manila's short-term PHIBOR rates higher.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) nudged higher for maturities of one week to three months, but the rest were either steady or lower, traders said on Wednesday.
"Everybody adjusted their swap points in the short-term in reflection of the money market trend," said a foreign bank dealer.

But the movement of the six-month and one-year PHIBOR rates mirrored the long-term view that interest rates would be lower due to the decelerating trend in inflation and the government's budget surplus position, he said.
